edits.old: | TC-E4-037-06 | 12.7 | Component | Writes and reads of the tables of 12.7 stay inside their owner's boundary; only payment_intent and the local decision record are written here and no money table exists (ASM-3438) |
edits.new:
| TC-E4-037-06 | 12.7 | Component | Writes and reads of the tables of 12.7 stay inside their owner's boundary; only payment_intent and the local decision record are written here and no money table exists (ASM-3438) |
| TC-E4-037-07 | AC3 | Component | A caller for a notice whose case is outside the scope answers 404; nothing changes |
| TC-E4-037-08 | AC4 | Component | A role without the right of the operation answers 403 with MSG-P4-002; nothing changes |
| TC-E4-037-09 | BR1, BR9, BR10 | Component | No money row and no other service's path or topic is declared; the act publishes no event of this service other than the library's DecisionRecorded |
| TC-E4-037-10 | BR8, BR11 | Component | No business value is in code; the paid state is read from the owner's answer and the missed or expired state from the consumed event, never computed here |
| TC-E4-037-11 | BR12, BR13 | Component | A closed case takes no new intent; a repeated POST with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first answer and writes no second intent |
| TC-E4-037-12 | BR14, BR15 | Component | A missing owner answer takes no intent and returns none as taken; a legal hold does not refuse the act and sends nothing outbound |

edits.old: | BR11 | The paid, missed or expired state of a reference arrives on the consumed payment event and from the owner's answer, and is never computed by this service | Architecture v5 slide 42 (event 12); event row of 12.4 |
edits.new: | BR11 | The paid state of a reference is read from the owner's answer until rwb-payment publishes a completed-payment event in the catalogue; the missed or expired state arrives on the consumed payment event; neither is computed by this service | Architecture v5 slide 42 (event 12); event row of 12.4 |

Added test rows TC-E4-037-09 to 12 covering BR1, BR8, BR9, BR10, BR11, BR12, BR13, BR14 and BR15.

disposition.change: Add the payment_intent entity of rwb_comms with its fields to LDM v9 and register it in Data Classification v5.
disposition.note: payment_intent is in neither LDM v9 nor Data Classification v5; the story cannot fix this.

disposition.change: Declare POST and GET /notices/{noticeId}/payment-intents under /api/recovery/comms/v1 with Idempotency-Key on the POST and statuses 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503.
disposition.note: The operations must be declared in the contract; the screen is the HOME.SCB customer screen, identifier left to channel stories.

disposition.change: Declare as consumed and faked rows the payment-intent registration of rwb-payment and the consent and contact-stop read of rwb-source-data, one hop with a 2 s budget; add C rows when P8 and P1 publish.

disposition.note: No source declares the payment_intent element set; section 11 and the migration in section 13 already name the table and indexes.
Parameters, reference data and rwb-decision source for the value sets are named in section 13; owner state, decision code and rule id added.

disposition.change: Declare one customer-facing capability area (name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1128)) with right C on the POST and right R on the GET; keep role lists in rwb-access; confirm with gateway-bff and ACE Common owners.
